nota: Cálculo sobre as duas datas de vigência da camada 21.
narracao: It never reached the tide line. So the strip is a legal handshake, drawn half a mile wide, so that one city could touch two others. A handshake is not a merger. That took almost three more years. The strip had taken the city to the harbor towns' boundary lines. The towns still had to say yes.
